name: Sitemap XML Generator
summary: Build a sitemap.xml from a manual list of URLs — locally in your browser.
description: Paste http(s) URLs one per line, optionally set lastmod, changefreq, and priority, and copy a standards-shaped urlset. Ideal for small sites and static lists. Nothing is crawled or uploaded.

faqs.question: Does it crawl my site?
faqs.answer: No. You provide the URL list manually.

faqs.question: What URL format is required?
faqs.answer: Absolute http or https URLs. Relative paths are rejected.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. XML is built entirely in your browser.
